inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Based upon the information gathered during the DFPS investigation, the operation failed to notify the parent that there was a situation at the operation that placed their child at risk
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon the information gathered during the DFPS investigation, after transitioning from the cafeteria to the classroom, a caregiver failed to noticed that a child left the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Based on the information obtained from the DFPS investigation, a caregiver was not aware of the children in their care and failed to conduct count of children during transitions to ensure all children present were accounted for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based upon the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, the operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation of an incident that placed a child at risk.  On 1/2/2024, an unsupervised child was able to exit the facility without being noticed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained from the DFPS investigation, an incident report had not been created and shared with the parent of a child who was placed at risk within the required 48 hr time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based upon the information obtained during the DFPS investigation,  a child was able to exit the facility without being noticed. The child was found at a convenience store in the area approximately 24 minutes later before being brought back to the operation by staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The emergency medical and treatment authorizations forms were not in the center's buses. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 1 lacked a health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: The center buses do not have the parents name and phone number or emergency telephone numbers for emergency contacts. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated,6 have not completed a valid CPR class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 6 lacked the address of the emergency contact.
Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The parent handbook does not inform parents of the requirements for physical activity and outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 3 were behind in immunizations.
Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food: The amount of food being eaten is not being written on the daily report sheets. This was corrected at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food (26 TAC §746.2431(2))
